name: First Match
description: Returns the first of several candidate inputs that equals a given value. Where M.ThresholdCompare compares a value against a constant and M.Categorization against declared conditions, this compares it against other columns — so it answers which input a value came from without re-deriving how it was chosen. Configured labels render the answer. Covers the time-to-event reason (ADTTE EVNTDESC: which of progression, death, lost-to-follow-up or last assessment supplied the analysis date) and any other 'which rule fired' indicator.

formula.notes: Candidates are evaluated in binding order, so ties resolve by declared priority. Comparison is on the value as stored, which for ISO-8601 dates is exact.

configurations.name: labels
configurations.description: Label per candidate, in the same order as the candidate bindings, pipe-separated (e.g. "Disease Progression|Death"). DataType admits only FHIR primitives, so a list is carried as a delimited string; the implementation also accepts a real vector when one is bound through env$configs. When unset, the candidate column names are used.

configurations.name: default_label
configurations.description: Emitted when no candidate matches the selected value.

output_classes.description: Label of the candidate that supplied the selected value.

assumptions: Each candidate is comparable to the selected value as stored
labels has one entry per candidate binding

input_roles.name: selected
input_roles.description: The value whose origin is being reported. Compared as stored, so ISO-8601 dates match exactly without parsing.

input_roles.name: candidate
input_roles.description: The candidate inputs the value may have come from, in priority order. Compared as stored.
